title: viebBook Android 2.7.2
notes:
Lernen now supports book-independent study packages from learning objectives. Import a PDF, photo or text to create a study guide, flashcards, a self-test and a mock exam with feedback and points. AI requests use the paired Mac, and saved packages sync with updated devices.

Built online by GitHub Actions after core regression tests and stable signing-certificate verification. Android 10 or newer. Built-in updates verify the installer and ask Android for installation approval. Matching-signature updates preserve books and answers.
